KurtsHouseKurtMakingBallsMustWaitText:
Hm? Who are you?

{PLAYER}, eh? You
want me to make some BALLS?

Sorry, but that'll
have to wait.

Do you know TEAM
ROCKET? Ah, don't

worry. I'll tell
you anyhow.

TEAM ROCKET's an
evil gang that

uses #MON for
their dirty work.

They're supposed
to have disbanded three years ago.

Anyway, they're at
the WELL, cutting

off SLOWPOKETAILS
for sale!

So I'm going to
go give them a lesson in pain!

Hang on, SLOWPOKE!
Old KURT is on his way!
KurtsHouseKurtHonoredToMakeBallsText:
KURT: Hi, {PLAYER}!

You handled your-
self like a real hero at the WELL.

I like your style!

I would be honored
to make BALLS for

a trainer like
you.

This is all I have
now, but take it.
KurtsHouseKurtBallsFromApricornsText:
KURT: I make BALLS
from APRICORNS.

Collect them from
trees and bring 'em to me.

I'll make BALLS
out of them.
KurtsHouseKurtAskYouHaveAnApricornText:
KURT: You have an
APRICORN for me?

Fine! I'll turn it
into a BALL.
KurtsHouseKurtItWillTakeADayText:
KURT: It'll take a
day to make you a

BALL. Come back
for it later.
KurtsHouseKurtDontBotherMeText:
KURT: I'm working!
Don't bother me!
KurtsHouseKurtJustFinishedYourBallText:
KURT: Ah, {PLAYER}!
I just finished your BALL. Here!
KurtsHouseKurtTurnedOutGreatText:
KURT: That turned
out great.

Try catching
#MON with it.
KurtsHouseKurtGranddaughterHelpingWorkFa:
KURT: Now that my
granddaughter is

helping me, I can
work much faster.
KurtsHouseKurtWhatIsThatText:
Wh-what is that?

I've never seen
one before.

It looks a lot
like a # BALL,

but it appears to
be something else.

Let me check it
for you.
KurtsHouseKurtThisBallStartedToShakeText:
{PLAYER}!

This BALL started
to shake while I was checking it.

There must be
something to this!
KurtsGranddaughterSlowpokeGoneText:
The SLOWPOKE are
gone… Were they

taken away by bad
people?
KurtsGranddaughterSlowpokeBackText:
The SLOWPOKE my
dad gave me came

back! Its TAIL is
growing back too!
KurtsGranddaughterDadText:
Dad works at SILPH
where he studies # BALLS.

I have to stay
home with Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.
KurtsGranddaughterHelpText:
I get to help
Grandpa now!

We'll make good
BALLS for you, so please wait!
KurtsGranddaughterGSBallText:
Grandpa's checking
a BALL right now.

So I'm waiting
till he's done.
KurtsHouseCelebiStatueText:
It's a statue of
the forest's pro- tector.
